title: User Registration with Email and Password - Successful Flow
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register using a valid email and password, receive a verification email, and complete email verification.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Input a valid email address and a password satisfying password policy
Submit the registration form
Verify that a verification email is sent to the registered email
Click the verification link in the email
Verify that the email is successfully verified and user can log in

title: User Registration with Email - Validation Errors
description: Validate that incomplete or invalid registration input fields show appropriate error messages and prevent registration.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Input invalid email formats and invalid passwords
Attempt to submit the registration form
Verify relevant validation error messages appear for email and password fields
Verify registration is not successful

title: User Registration with Google OAuth - Successful Flow
description: Verify that a user can register and login via Google OAuth authentication successfully with correct redirection and tokens.

steps.description: Navigate to the login or registration page
Click the Google OAuth login button
Complete Google account authorization when prompted
Verify user is logged in and redirected to the main dashboard page
Verify JWT token is issued and stored securely

title: User Login with Email and Password - Successful and Failure Scenarios
description: Verify login using email/password works correctly for valid credentials and returns meaningful errors for invalid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid email and correct password
Click login button
Verify user is logged in and token is issued
Logout and navigate back to login
Input valid email and incorrect password
Click login button
Verify login fails with error message about invalid credentials

title: ID Verification Submission and Admin Approval Workflow
description: Verify user can upload front and back images for ID verification, submit for approval, and admin can approve or reject with system update.

steps.description: User navigates to ID verification section and uploads valid front and back images
User submits the ID verification request
Verify submission is recorded and status is pending
Admin logs in and accesses the verification queue
Admin reviews ID images and approves the verification
Verify user account status updates to verified and user receives notification
Admin rejects another verification request with reasons
Verify user receives rejection notification and can re-submit

title: Incident Report Creation - Complete Flow with Valid Input and AI Image Analysis
description: Verify that users can create incident reports through the multi-step wizard, including text input, location selection by GPS/map/manual entry, image uploads with AI categorization, review, and final submission with offline support.

steps.description: User opens the Create Report wizard
Input all required incident details including title, description (within character limits), and select incident category
Choose location using GPS, map picker, and manual coordinate entry; verify location accuracy
Upload up to 5 images with supported formats and sizes
Verify AI-powered image analysis runs and suggests categories, detecting inappropriate content
Review and confirm report details
Submit the report
Verify report is saved with a unique identifier and status set to 'submitted'
Simulate offline mode during creation and submission
Verify offline submission is queued and syncs correctly when online

title: Incident Report Creation - Invalid Input and Content Moderation
description: Verify that the report creation wizard validates input fields, enforces character limits, restricts invalid image formats or sizes, handles AI content moderation flags properly, and prevents submission with invalid data.

steps.description: Start incident report creation and input missing or invalid required fields
Verify appropriate validation error messages appear
Upload images exceeding size limits or unsupported formats
Verify error messages about image format/size are shown and upload is blocked
Upload images flagged by AI moderation as inappropriate
Verify user is warned and prevented from submitting report containing inappropriate content
Attempt to submit report with invalid data
Verify submission is blocked and errors are shown

title: Real-Time Interactive Dashboard Map Updates and Filtering
description: Verify that the dashboard map displays incident reports in real-time with clustering, status-based filtering, and ability to update statuses and assignments resulting in immediate UI updates.

steps.description: Login as admin and open the interactive dashboard with map view
Verify map loads with clustered report markers grouped by proximity
Apply filters by report status and categories
Verify map updates to show only matching reports
Change status of a report and assign it to a group via admin controls
Verify updates reflect immediately on map and report list
Simulate report status changes from patrol officer devices
Verify real-time dashboard updates received with latency under 3 seconds

title: Patrol Dashboard Job Assignment, Navigation and Status Updates
description: Verify patrol officers can receive job assignments, accept or reject them, use navigation features integrated with OpenStreetMap and Google Maps, update job status, and complete reports with proof documents.

steps.description: Login as patrol officer and view pending job assignments
Accept a job assignment
Verify job appears in active jobs list and navigation to incident location is available
Engage navigation system with route and waypoint tracking
Verify routing displays accurate directions and updates location in real-time
Update job status through workflow steps (en route, on scene, completed)
Upload proof images or documentation for completed report
Verify status updates sync to system and job is marked completed

title: Real-Time Communication Module - Chat Between Users and Admins
description: Verify real-time chat functionality including sending and receiving messages, typing indicators, read receipts, message history persistence, and notifications using Socket.IO.

steps.description: User initiates real-time chat conversation with admin
Send text messages from user to admin
Verify messages are delivered instantly with typing indicators shown
Admin replies to user messages
Verify read receipts update as messages are read
Simulate network disconnect and reconnect
Verify chat automatically reconnects and no messages are lost
Verify push notifications are received on new messages when app is in background

title: Admin Portal User Management with Role-Based Access Control
description: Ensure admin users can manage user accounts, update roles, verify identities, and changes reflect immediately with correct enforcement of permissions by role.

steps.description: Admin logs into Admin Dashboard and opens user management section
View list of users with current roles and verification statuses
Update roles of a selected user and verify changes
Verify role change reflects immediately in database and UI
Try accessing admin features with a user logged in with different roles to verify RBAC enforcement
Verify access is granted or denied correctly per role

title: Gamification Mechanics - Points, Achievements, and Leaderboards
description: Verify points allocation for qualifying actions, proper achievement badge awarding, experience level updates, and correct leaderboard ranking with pagination and trend analytics.

steps.description: Perform various user actions (e.g., report submission, comments, likes) that trigger points allocation
Verify points are correctly added to user account
Verify achievements are unlocked and badges displayed as expected
Access leaderboard page
Verify leaderboard ranks users correctly with pagination for large data sets
Verify trend analytics reflect changes in user ranking over time

title: Push Notifications Delivery and Preferences
description: Verify push notifications are delivered via Firebase Cloud Messaging for report status changes, messages, announcements, and achievement unlocks; respects user permissions and preferences.

steps.description: Enable push notifications on supported device after permission request
Verify notification permission request dialog is properly shown
Trigger events causing different push notifications (e.g., report status update, new message, admin announcement, achievement unlock)
Verify notifications are received on device with correct content
Change user notification preferences to disable certain notification types
Trigger disabled notification types
Verify disabled notifications are not delivered

title: PWA Offline Mode and Service Worker Functionality
description: Verify the app works offline with cached data, queuing actions like report submission for syncing when network returns, service worker management, and proper install prompts display.

steps.description: Load the app and allow service worker to cache resources
Turn off network connection and navigate through app pages
Verify cached content loads correctly and user can navigate
Create incident report while offline
Verify the report creation is queued and indicated as pending synchronization
Restore network connection
Verify queued reports automatically sync and status updates
Trigger PWA install prompt and accept install
Verify app installs as PWA and launches from home screen

title: Authentication Token Management and Security
description: Verify secure authentication flow with JWT tokens: token issuance at login, secure storage, expiration handling, refresh token functionality, and prevention of unauthorized access.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials and inspect JWT token generation
Verify token is securely stored (e.g., HttpOnly cookie or secure storage)
Simulate token expiry and trigger token refresh flow
Verify new token is issued without requiring full re-login
Attempt to access protected resources with expired or missing token
Verify access is denied and user is prompted to authenticate

title: Data Security and Compliance with GDPR and Input Validation
description: Verify end-to-end encrypted communication, data protection policies, prevention of common security vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection), comprehensive input validation on all user inputs.

steps.description: Test submission of various inputs including scripts or SQL injection payloads in all input fields
Verify input validation blocks malicious content and sanitizes input
Inspect communication between client and server for encryption (HTTPS/WSS enforced)
Verify all data transferred is encrypted and secure
Test CSRF by trying to submit requests from unauthorized origins
Verify CSRF protection mechanisms prevent such requests

title: Performance Benchmarking for Load Times and Animation Smoothness
description: Verify the app meets performance criteria with First Contentful Paint under 1.5s, Time to Interactive under 3.5s, API response times under 3s, and animation frame rates at 60 FPS.

steps.description: Load the landing page and key app pages on standard broadband and mobile network speeds
Measure and verify FCP is under 1.5 seconds
Measure and verify TTI is under 3.5 seconds
Perform typical user interactions with animations and transitions
Verify animations run smoothly at 60 FPS
Measure response times for backend API calls during navigation and report submissions
Verify all API responses return within 3 seconds

title: Admin Announcement Management with Priority and Audience Targeting
description: Verify that admins can create, edit, schedule, and delete announcements with priority levels and target audiences; announcements display correctly in user views.

steps.description: Admin creates new announcement with title, content, priority level, target audience selection, and expiration date
Verify announcement is saved and visible in admin announcement list
Verify announcement displays correctly to targeted users in announcements carousel
Edit announcement to update content and priority
Verify updates are reflected immediately in user views
Delete announcement before expiration
Verify announcement is removed from user views

title: User Profile Management and Avatar Upload
description: Verify users can update profile information, upload avatars with image format and size validation, and review personal statistics and achievements.

steps.description: User navigates to profile management page
Edit editable fields with valid and invalid inputs
Verify validation messages for invalid inputs and successful update for valid inputs
Upload avatar image and verify format/size restrictions
Verify uploaded avatar displays correctly
View personal statistics and achievements
Verify statistics and achievements data is accurate and updated

title: Network Status Monitoring and Offline Queue Handling
description: Verify app correctly detects online/offline status changes, monitors connection quality, queues user actions performed offline, and synchronizes them properly when connectivity is restored.

steps.description: Open app and confirm network status is shown as online
Switch network connection off
Verify UI updates to show offline status
Perform user actions such as creating reports or sending chat messages during offline
Verify actions are queued locally and indicated as pending
Restore network connection
Verify queued actions are automatically synced and confirmed processed by backend
